preserved_aspect_axes.answer_disposition: pending | answered_supported | answered_qualified | unresolved_disclosed | unresolved_undisclosed | excluded_with_reason | merged_into

add_fields.predicate_snapshot: complete typed predicates with current answer/evidence/check refs; no gold
add_fields.matched_rule_ids: all applicable invalid/review rules or exactly one runtime row
add_fields.unresolved_aspects: structured ID/reason/disclosure records; IDs must equal retained unresolved_aspect_ids

Finalization.final_status: seven inherited runtime statuses, nullable only for INVALID_STATE/REQUIRES_REVIEW; no positive runtime assertion in those dispositions
Finalization.compatibility: answer_status equals completeness_state; retain both during compatibility period. Do not rewrite legacy V1 traces. Inconsistent aliases are INVALID_STATE.

provider_physical_attempts.applies_to: Every production provider request; evaluator attempts share scheduler if domain matches, with separate payload/ledger storage.

orchestration_only_design_records.test_release_seal: Implementation, architecture, prompts, policies, budgets, evaluation config hashes, role declarations, access approval before query release. No TEST gold or quality outcomes in runtime config.
orchestration_only_design_records.exposure_event: Timestamp, recipient/role, channel, affected query hashes/cluster IDs, retained-knowledge scope, claim downgrade or future independent-cohort disposition; durable append-only, never deleted to restore untouched claim.
orchestration_only_design_records.phase5c5_authorization: Final v2 definition, primary/secondary contrasts, exact authorized mechanism bundle membership, R3 confirmation/defer decision; sealed before implementation and TEST exposure.
orchestration_only_design_records.margin_approval: Annotated structure/rubric bindings, symbols/values/rationale, reviewers and approval date; current approved values null.
orchestration_only_design_records.quota_config: Separate domain configurations when pools differ; shared global scheduling when same.
